voice_mode: prototype_tts_only; final recorded VO is production work

start.text: Three angles should make one answer. Let’s see if they do.

darius.text: Central gives me the first piece.

malik.text: Workshop gives me the second. Funny how everything needs wheels.

amara.text: The information is consistent. That is the part I dislike.

converge.text: Three angles, one lead. Now we know where to look.

complete.text: A shared lead is useful. Trust is still a separate problem.

start.text: We give them something to chase. It just will not be the thing we care about.

decoy-prepare.text: The decoy looks convincing. That is enough.

decoy-deliver.text: Real package stays hidden. Let the wrong people celebrate.

start.text: Keep the target moving. I need the identity, not a crash.

target-locate.text: There. Same route pattern as before.

chase-maintain.text: I can see them. Just keep me from doing anything stupid.

identify.text: We have the face and the route.

complete.text: Now the chase has a name attached to it.

start.text: If somebody hid a door, somebody expected somebody else to miss it.

search-mark.text: That mark is too deliberate to be decoration.

clue-retrieve.text: Got the clue. Whoever left it wanted us to keep going.

complete.text: A door that was not there. Until we found it.

start.text: Empty offices are rarely empty. They are just finished being used.

file-recover.text: File recovered. We leave before the building remembers us.

complete.text: The office was empty. The evidence was not.

start.text: Clean money needs a clean place to go.

return-record.text: A return is proof the door can stay open.

complete.text: First investment made. We finally have a foothold that can explain itself.

start.text: We need a place nobody can casually take from us.

safehouse-unlock.text: This can work. Needs locks, discipline, and less talking.

secure.text: Secure the perimeter. This becomes our fallback.

vehicle-store.text: Runner is parked. Home sweet questionable home.

complete.text: Safehouse is ours. That changes how we move.

start.text: Three anomalies are enough to prove a pattern. Find them.

anomaly-3.text: Third anomaly. Now it is a system.

complete.text: The books are talking. We only had to read them.

start.text: This lead is about my brother. I am not handing it off.

location-search.text: No one stays invisible forever. Check the place again.

complete.text: The trail continues. Now it points somewhere specific.

start.text: They found us. So we make sure they do not keep us.

attack-survive.text: Keep moving. We can be scared later.

escape.text: Out of the attack zone. Keep the evidence intact.

evidence-preserve.text: Evidence preserved. They wanted it gone.

complete.text: They found us once. Next time, we are ready.
